title: Carasent AB (publ) – Interim report January–June 2025
content:
Carasent AB (publ) – Interim Report January–June 2025

Q2 2025 Performance Highlights:
- Net sales reached 82.9 million SEK, a 26% increase from 65.9 million SEK in the prior year period
- Achieved 13% organic growth, while acquisitions and divestments contributed an additional 14 percentage points
- Recurring revenues climbed to 76.1 million SEK compared to 60.8 million SEK, demonstrating strong recurring revenue expansion of 13% organically
- EBITDA improved to 12.1 million SEK from 7.8 million SEK, yielding a 15% margin versus 12% previously
- Operating results showed pressure, with EBIT declining to -3.7 million SEK from -7.6 million SEK
- Net income was negative at -5.5 million SEK versus -5.7 million SEK
- Earnings per share totaled -0.08 SEK

H1 2025 Full Results:
- Net sales reached 168.1 million SEK, representing 27% total growth with 14% organic expansion
- EBITDA grew to 26.0 million SEK from 14.0 million SEK, improving the margin to 15% from 11%
